items.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: I’ll never forget when I was with Bob Haggart and Yank Lawson, and it was with a band, it was called the World’s Greatest Jazz Band.

ctx.x: They have to write about it. Yeah. How much — have you been able to do some traveling around outside the country in some of the groups you’ve played?

Quite a bit. Australia, Japan, Europe, Great Britain. I’ll never forget when I was with Bob Haggart and Yank Lawson, and it was with a band, it was called the World’s Greatest Jazz Band. Of course none of the musicians named it that, it was a guy that started, that got the thing together with the help of Bob Haggart and Yank Lawson, they called it the World’s Greatest Jazz Band. I’ll never forget one time we were playing in Honolulu, and then we came back and played one night in San Francisco at a place called…
